Cara S.: Quick handoff for AtlasHealth (enterprise, HIPAA). Contract executed 2024-03-28. They require private deploy in us-east-1 on dedicated capacity (2 GPUs). SSO via Okta + SCIM. Legal/DPA still in review (~2w). Trial 30d; customer expects enablement week of 2024-04-12. Sales gave sanitized dataset and list of 10 critical flows. Renewal risk if onboarding falls outside trial. CS to own kickoff; Support/Eng to own infra + deploy. @Mike C. to lead kickoff, @Jen S. for support, @Alex G. for engineering.

Mike C.: Opening CS-6102. Need Okta dev admin + SCIM test tenant creds, static IPs for allowlist, and example prompts. Tentative kickoff 2024-03-29 11:00 ET.

Cara S.: Shared 1Password path and contract link in CS-6102. Sales note: customer will share prompt set and dataset by EOD.

Jen S.: Support checklist: peering/VPN, certs, KMS roles, SIEM hook, monitoring dashboards. Flagging HSM as optional pending Legal. I'll add escalation at 14 days for legal delay.

Alex G.: We'll prepare a 2-GPU private template + deploy runbook and fallback routing to hosted model. Need sequence length distribution and peak concurrency to tune kernels. p95 latency target requested: <=200ms; may need quantization.

Priya R.: Enablement plan: 2 sessions (admin + prompt engineering). I'll build a small eval harness for the 10 critical flows and capture latency + relevance. Propose acceptance: p95 latency <250ms, relevance >=0.7.

legal-bot: DPA status: draft sent 2024-03-28. ETA review 14 days. HSM clause: pending.

Mike C.: Owners & milestones:
- CS kickoff & agenda (Mike C.)  due 2024-03-29
- Support infra tickets (Jen S.)  due 2024-04-03
- Infra template & runbook (Alex G.)  due 2024-04-05
- Enablement + eval harness (Priya R.)  due 2024-04-09
- Legal/DPA (Cara)  track by Sales
I'll post weekly updates. :thumbsup:

Cara S.: Thanks everyone. If Legal or customer stalls, escalate to me.

onboard-bot: Kickoff scheduled 2024-03-29 11:00 ET. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/atlas-onboard.
